# Sift Agent Context

Sift is the unified GCP/GKE operational-event service. Its raw journal is the
canonical source of truth for logs, spans, exceptions, direct metric points
with exemplars, audit events, and change events.

## Workflow

- Capability contract: `README.md`
- Tech design: `tech-design/`
- Readiness: `aw health --project sift full`
- Verify TD: `aw td check tech-design`

## Commands

- Build debug: `./build.sh debug`
- Build release profile: `./build.sh release`
- Test: `cargo test -p sift`
- Run: `sift serve --data-dir ./sift-data`
- Contract: `sift spec`
- Agent documentation: `sift llm --topic outline`

## Service contract

`POST /v1/events` acknowledges only after the raw-event journal append has
been fsynced. Reuse an `event_id` to retry idempotently. HTTP/1.1 and h2c use
one port; standard routes are `/healthz`, `/readyz`, `/metrics`,
`/openapi.json`, and `/docs`.
